attBesluta.text: I have a small motorhome so I bought this to stack small appliances on to save room. I love it. It’s easy to fold glad for traveling. It works great
This cart is absolutely amazing Best Buy in a long time Strongly Recommend
I’m a ‹NAMN› Detailer. I was looking for a cart just like this to take in my mobile unit that fit. This is perfect.
Great product very sturdy we use it for all kinds of things around the house and even take it to camp and use it for a table to put food on while grilling we even had almost 300 lbs on it

Acquisto a settembre 2026 questo carrello per riporre degli elettromedicali pesanti quando non li porto al lavoro. Davvero molto robusto può portare anche 20 kg per ogni ripiano. Le ruote scorrono benissimo ed i blocchi sono utili. Si apre e chiude in un attimo ed è molto leggero e posso riporlo chiuso ovunque. Davvero un ottimo prodotto ed altrettanto ottimo il rapporto qualità prezzo!

Good cart. Easy to fold and load into the SUV. I'm an commissioning engineer and I use this to carry my laptop, collapsible chair, and testing tools into data centers. It doubles as a monitor stand to mirror the laptop when clients want to see what I'm looking at on my screen too.

I use this cart for my tools as I service commercial kitchens. it fits in my service van easily as it folds. It has good lips on the sides so nothing slides off and rolls easily. I was always borrowing carts from the staff at the restaurant but now I have my own. Holds more weight than I thought. Well worth the money.
Very useful for helping "food pantry" recipients move past tables, picking up needed items. Good value for the price.
